'''Noan Jeraddi''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who served in the Tatooine Patrol.

{{Char-stub}}
==Biography==
Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] Patrol discovered [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], the personally [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], abandoned in geosynchronous orbit of the planet Tatooine. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Noan Jeraddi, with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tepra Tseelit]], wrote Incident Report 39:3:22 detailing what happened to ''Slave I'' and the blast-proof strongbox found in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].
